Nose correction because the tip of the nose is starting to thin and the tip of the nose is starting to curve. The doctor used the technique of augmentation using (Brown Silicone), which is a shape similar to a Mantis shape mixed with a Barbie shape, which is a high shape like a Mantis but the bridge of the nose slopes like a Barbie. The silicone is brown in color, suitable for people with little nasal flesh or thin skin because when light hits it, the silicone will not reflect light clearly.

And used the technique of augmentation by supporting the tip with artificial tissue.

The doctor chose a sloped, upturned nose shape to match our face.

The doctor explained to us as follows...

Normally, Thais like to augment their noses with silicone nose rods. It will be augmented along the entire length of the bridge to the tip of the nose. For some patients with little nasal flesh and thin skin, the doctor must be careful about the tip of the nose, which is the most prone area to perforation. Therefore, artificial tissue materials are used to support the tip of the nose to prevent the silicone from directly touching the silicone rod and the skin of the tip of the nose. This reduces the risk of a perforated nose or a thin tip, and also makes the nose shape more beautiful and proportionate.

Sloping nose surgery is a nose tip that is raised up. This nose shape is the opposite of the teardrop nose. It is a nose shape that requires nose augmentation with a decorated tip. This shape is very popular among foreigners because it makes the face look sharp, sharp, and sour in a Western style. The characteristic is that the tip of the nose is slightly raised. When smiling, the nose does not curve down. It looks in shape all the time. For those who want to be beautiful and sharp, this shape is the most suitable because it looks like a Western nose. However, people who are suitable for this nose shape should have a hooked nose or a rather wide nose. It helps lift the tip of the nose, up, and solves the problem of a hooked and wide nose tip.
